purpose: Test source-image-normalized candidate allocation and select one global probe mode on disjoint training calibration, then confirm once on an excluded-history training-source cohort.
new_algorithm: Normalize detached region weights within each source image, average active source-image objectives; retain candidates, transforms, optimizer, reset, and inherited dataset settings.

selection.uses: Only the two new calibration results, never any confirmation labels or scores.
selection.primary: Maximize the worst-dataset mIoU difference versus image_confidence across PC60 and COCO Object.
tie_order: fewer actual diagnostic encoder inputs over calibration images
fixed mode ordering T then C then min

protocol.configuration: Inherited sealed dataset tuple for every arm; no new lr/steps/K/batch search.
protocol.calibration: Predict both datasets/all six arms and seal all before reading calibration labels; score, select, and seal exactly one global mode.
protocol.confirmation: Predict all six arms for both datasets and all three orders before any confirmation label read; all outcomes retained, not only selected mode.
protocol.images: Official training pools excluding all identifiable historical method/configuration-development IDs and official evaluation identities. Hash-ranked without labels; calibration and confirmation disjoint.
protocol.exposure_scope: Prospective confirmation relative to the documented exclusion inventory; missing historical records are disclosed, not silently certified absent.
protocol.scoring: Existing pooled class intersection/union,224-grid nearest labels and query/category mapping; no candidate GT or new metric/threshold.
protocol.cost: Independent zero/one/two-probe execution and actual encoder counts, synchronized model-side timing; no setup/decode/H2D/scoring in timing, only episode0 omitted from time, all images in accuracy/counters.
protocol.gates: CPU numeric/gradient/reset tests and two real four-image GT-free gates; one-source-image balanced-min equals old min within fixed1e-5 loss/support tolerance and zero changed labels; count all view schedules.
protocol.runtime: Frozen new source snapshot/manifest, deterministic default attention, shared single-GPU lock,systemd12GiB RAM/1GiB swap,RemainAfterExit=yes,no retry/resume/overwrite.
protocol.bound: Two calibration cells and six confirmation cells,48 arm results plus two four-image GT-free gates. No automatic dataset/backbone expansion or subsequent full search.
protocol.statistics: All three order-specific contrasts/ranges retained; no pixel/candidate independence or deterministic-seed uncertainty claim. No bootstrap added against prior user instruction.

adoption_gate: Do not replace current full-split paper with partial cohort evidence. Inspect fixed selected mode on both confirmation datasets and all orders; no test-based mode switch. Any further full split or new algorithm is a separately frozen next stage.
comparison_instruction: Do not rerun MLMP where published values exist, in accordance with user instruction; this stage isolates algorithm allocation and cost, not matched external-method superiority.
